I opened it and walked through it — the pop-up over my library feels right. I like that I paste an address, it goes off and reads the page, and then shows me the title, description, icon, and a preview picture it found. That's exactly the "take care of the details" feeling I wanted, and starting from just the web address is natural.

One thing on that "here's what we found" screen, though: it shows me the title and description but I can only either save it or go back. Sometimes what a page calls itself isn't quite how I'd want to remember it — the title might be too long or a bit off. I'd want to be able to tweak the title and description right there before I hit save, rather than being stuck with whatever it grabbed. Can we make those editable at that step?

Otherwise the beginning of saving feels like the right way in.
